messages:
Mira: Heads up — we have 2 external visitors from BeamWorks arriving at 2pm. Do they need pre-registered badges or can reception handle walk-ins?
Reception: Pre-registration is preferred but we can do same-day temporary badges. Please email names + company to reception@redwood.com. For same-day guests we print a paper badge at the front desk.
Sasha: If they're staying in the product area, can we reserve 2 seats in Flex A? I tried the desk app but not sure if guests show up.
Matt: Guests don't appear in personal desk bookings. People Ops/reception should add a visitor booking for Flex A. @People Ops can confirm.
People Ops: Confirmed — send over full names and an approximate arrival time. We'll add them to the visitor list and reserve 2 hot desks in Flex A. Note: Wi‑Fi for guests is `Guest-Redwood` (expires in 24h). If they need temporary SSO access to demo anything, include the email addresses and we'll handle a short-term Okta guest entry.
Mira: Great — also one wants to ship a small demo kit ahead of time. Where should the courier address it?
Reception: Ship to: `Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Mira (BeamWorks visitors)
[Office street address]`. Please mark "Front Desk" and include the expected delivery date. For same-day courier drop, ask them to ring buzzer 1A.
Oliver: FYI heavier packages (>20lb) go to receiving and we ping the recipient for pickup. If it's fragile, write "Fragile" on the label and include tracking # in the email to reception.
Mira: Sending names + tracking now. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
DoorBot: visitor_checkin: 2 guests from BeamWorks pre-registered by Mira. Badges printed at 14:01.
